response.justification: Despite a strong general software engineering background, the candidate lacks demonstrable professional C++ experience on Windows and has no evidence of capital markets, fixed income, or investment banking domain exposure — both mandatory requirements for this role.
strengths: Extensive full-stack development experience across multiple languages and platforms
Strong DevOps and CI/CD practices demonstrated through infrastructure setup and tooling
Active open-source contributor with proven ability to build and maintain complex systems
concerns: No visible professional C++ experience on Windows platform as required
No domain experience in fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking
SQL experience listed but not contextualized in financial systems or enterprise databases like SQL Server/Oracle
